candidates.change_summary: Make owner() return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Invert the returned paused flag (return !paused() instead of paused()) so paused() reports the opposite of the stored paused state.
Change the default royaltyBPS from 500 to 1000 so getRoyalties returns doubled royaltyBPS when token-specific recipient is zero.
When uninitialized, return default royalties instead of reverting (removes NotInitialized revert).
If token-specific configuration exists return recipient only (zero BPS) — set royaltyBPS to 0 when config present.
